verdict.rationale: Firecrawl's extract/scrape JSON format lets developers supply a natural-language prompt plus optional schema instead of writing selectors (firecrawl-docs-16, firecrawl-gh-7), and the AI agent mode explicitly works from natural-language descriptions with no URLs required (firecrawl-gh-1). Docs also show local file extraction to structured JSON without selectors (firecrawl-docs-6, firecrawl-docs-15). missing for 10: independent/hands-on benchmark of extraction accuracy from prompts vs schemas, and no community corroboration specifically validating NL-driven extraction quality.
